meta.title: Little Grass Shack · Hawaiian BBQ · Ericeira
meta.description: Aloha! Little Grass Shack is a roadside Hawaiian BBQ joint coming soon to Ribamar, Ericeira. Slow-smoked island flavours by the sea.

hero.title: Little Grass Shack
hero.subtitle: A little roadside shack serving up slow-smoked island flavours, aloha spirit and ice-cold vibes. Pull over, kick off your slippers and stay a while.

countdown.title: Grand opening in
countdown.subtitle: The grill is warming up. Here's the countdown to your first plate.
countdown.openSubtitle: The shack is fired up and the plates are hot. Come say aloha.

about.title: Aloha from the roadside
about.body: Think smoky kalua pork, huli-huli chicken, fresh pineapple and the salty Atlantic breeze. Little Grass Shack brings a taste of the islands to the surf coast of Ericeira — honest island food, cooked low and slow, served with a smile.
